SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES




                      SOAH ORDER NO. 20
              DENYING MOTION FOR CONTINUANCE,
           GRANTING LEAVE FOR LATE-FILED TESTIMONY,
           DENYING MOTIONS TO STRIKE TESTIMONY, AND
             DENYING MOTIONS TO EXTEND DEADLINES

I.    MOTION FOR CONTINUANCE

      On May 13, 2026, John Bradley filed a motion for a 30-day continuance to
allow for a comprehensive geological assessment of his property. This matter is
 subject to the 180-day deadline of PURA section 37.057, and no authority was cited
that would allow for an extension of that statutory deadline. Accordingly,
John Bradley’s motion for continuance is DENIED.


II.     LATE-FILED TESTIMONY AND EXHIBITS

        On May 14, 2026, intervenors represented by Donald Grissom1 filed a joint
motion for leave for late-filed direct testimony and exhibits. The filing indicates that
the late filing was due to the compressed timeline, misunderstanding of the filing
deadline (5:00 p.m. rather than midnight), and the time required for the PUC
Interchange System to process, confirm, and generate receipts for each filing. The
motion states good cause and is GRANTED. The intervenors represented by
Donald Grissom’s late-filed testimony and exhibits are accepted.


III.    OBJECTIONS AND MOTIONS TO STRIKE

        On May 18, 2026, Link R1 Opposition Landowners filed objections to and
motion to strike portions of the direct testimony of intervenors due to non-expert,
hearsay, non-authenticated, and conclusory statements. On the same day, Oncor
Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation
(collectively, Applicants) filed objections to and motion to strike intervenor
testimony due to non-expert opinion, non-relevant, and hearsay statements. On the
same day, Reliance Ranches, LLC and Chanas Ranch, LLC filed objections and



1 The intervenors represented by Donald H. Grisson include Dennis Cabaniss, Boyce Cabaniss, Debby Peterson,

Michael Schulte, Kellianne Jenkins, Steven Keith Pate, Brett Stewart, John Barry Winder, Raul Gonzales,
Jill DeVilleneuve, Donald Schaetz, Misty Hoenig, Crystal Hutchinson, Lisa Lima, Linda Nail, Paige Gist,
Kyle McFather, Joshua Shaver, Victoria Herndon, Michael Gier, Michelle Dawn King, and Dustin King.
                                                    2
                                        SOAH Order No. 20
                          SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
 motions to strike intervenors’ testimony due to lack of personal knowledge, non-
expert opinion testimony, and lack of authentication.


      The objections of Link R1 Opposition Landowners, Applicants, and Reliance
Ranches, LLC and Chanas Ranch, LLC are OVERRULED, and their motions to
strike are DENIED. The objections may be considered with respect to the weight
given to the testimony rather than the admissibility.


IV.   MOTIONS FOR DEADLINE EXTENSIONS

      On May 19, 2026, Applicants filed a motion for extension of the objection
deadlines for all requests for information (RFIs) received on or after May 15, 2026.
On May 19, 2026, Jason Howton filed a response to Applicants’ motion and
cross-motion for extension of related deadlines, indicating that Mr. Howton is
unopposed to Applicants’ requested extension and seeks extension of the deadlines
for cross-rebuttal testimony deadline, objections to cross-rebuttal testimony, and
serving discovery on Applicants’ rebuttal testimony.


      Discovery deadlines between parties may be extended upon written
agreement between the parties propounding and responding to the discovery
without the Administrative Law Judges’ approval. To the extent that Applicants
obtain written agreement from particular intervenors, their objections deadline to
those RFIs may be extended. However, the deadlines for cross-rebuttal testimony
and objections to cross-rebuttal testimony remain as set in SOAH Order No. 6. Due
to the compressed procedural schedule in this matter, extending these deadlines is


                                             3
                                   SOAH Order No. 20
                     SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
 not feasible. Applicants and Mr. Howton’s motions for deadline extensions are
DENIED.


Signed May 27, 2026

Cassandra Quinn                                Linda Brite

______________________
Dee Marlo Chico
Administrative Law Judge
